articles.text: テーラー: Mr. Ogawa, this is Mr. Kelly. Mr. Kelly, this is Mr. Ogawa. (Teeraa: Mr. Ogawa, this is Mr. Kelly. Mr. Kelly, this is Mr. Ogawa.)
TAYLOR: (in English) Mr. Ogawa, this is Mr. Kelly. Mr. Kelly, this is Mr. Ogawa.
小川: How do you do? Pleased to meet you. (Ogawa: How do you do? Pleased to meet you.)
OGAWA: (in English) How do you do? Pleased to meet you.
ケリー: ケリーです。はじめまして。これは家内です。 (Kerii: Kerii desu. Hajimemashite. Kore wa kanai desu.)
KELLY: My name is Kelly. How do you do? This is my wife.
ケリー(奥さん): はじめまして。どうぞよろしく。 (Kerii (okusan): Hajimemashite. Doozo yoroshiku.)
MRS. KELLY: How do you do? Pleased to meet you.
小川: 日本語がお上手ですね。 (Ogawa: Nihongo ga ojoozu desu ne.)
OGAWA: You speak Japanese very well.
ケリー(奥さん): いいえ、まだまだです。 (Kerii (okusan): Iie, madamada desu.)
MRS. KELLY: Oh, no. We're still beginners.
